name: compiler
description: Invoke the Factory's Stage 5 IS-to-Executable Specification compiler

prd_path.description: Path to the Intent Specification markdown file under specs/intent-specifications/

mode.description: full = all 8 passes + Coherence Verification + Executable Specification emission; dry-run = all 8 passes but no file writes; coherenceVerification-only = stops after Coherence Verification, emits only the Verification Report

preconditions: Intent Specification front-matter is well-formed YAML
source_refs in Intent Specification are resolvable
side_effects: emits intermediate artifacts per pass to .factory/intermediates/ (gitignored)
emits VerificationReport to specs/verification-reports/ on every run
emits Executable Specification to specs/executable-specifications/ on successful Coherence Verification

output_contract.on_success: Executable Specification YAML written + VerificationReport (overall: pass)
output_contract.on_coherenceVerification_fail: VerificationReport (overall: fail) written; NO Executable Specification emitted; exit code 10
output_contract.on_uncertainty: UncertaintyLedger written; compiler halts; exit code 20
output_contract.on_internal_error: error with pass number and artifact; exit code 1

pass.description: Run a single compiler pass. For debugging; not the normal pipeline.
